entities.name: Gorev Hadszak
entities.description: A grizzled retired Wojek on Ravnica who once served at Sunhome under Razia.

entities.name: Pel Javya
entities.description: Gorev's nephew, who resolved to fight the Dimir.

entities.name: Guildpact
entities.description: The greatest spell ever cast, dissolved on the day commemorated.

entities.name: Szadek
entities.description: Dimir vampire lord in the play.

entities.name: Agrus Kos
entities.description: Detective who faced Szadek in the play.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: Boros parun under whom Gorev served at Sunhome.

entities.name: Dimir
entities.description: Guild lying out of sight in the Undercity.

entities.name: Thespian's Stage
entities.description: Theatre where the play was staged.

entities.name: Augustin
entities.description: Opponent in the play alongside Szadek.

events.summary: On the Guildpact's dissolution anniversary Gorev took Pel Javya to see a play about the event.
events.quote: Gorev took his nephew Pel Javya to see a theatre play about the historic event that marked the day

events.summary: Gorev told Pel the play was a tragedy about the destruction of the Guildpact.
events.quote: It was about the destruction of the greatest creation ever put on paper.

events.summary: Pel concluded the real fight lay in the Undercity against the Dimir, a message that would shape his life's work.
events.quote: Pel Javya knew that the real fight for Ravnica lay strewn throughout the Undercity
